name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA between two parties.

name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Mutual NDA; captures the deal-specific terms and incorporates the standard terms by reference.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for providing and purchasing cloud software services (SaaS).

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Service level commitments such as uptime and support response times for a cloud service.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Terms governing processing of personal data by a vendor on behalf of a customer.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Terms for an early-stage product customer who gives feedback while using a pre-release product.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Terms for professional services engagements, including statements of work and deliverables.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Terms for a business partnership such as referral, reseller or co-marketing relationships.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA business associate terms for handling protected health information.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Terms for licensing software to a customer.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Terms for a time-limited trial or pilot of a product for evaluation purposes.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum covering use of AI features and customer data in AI services.
